old_problem: Link enable/disable requires observable scoped disappearance and return, not just a final healthy endpoint. The control hierarchy, siblings, quiesce, disable acknowledgement, re-enable/retrain deadlines, identity/function acceptance and iterations were unspecified, while log clearing could erase first-fault evidence.
disposition_reason: The source defines Test #26 true link disable/enable interoperability. The exact vendor primitive, hierarchy, iteration/timing, absence/return contract, identity/function oracle and recovery are runtime Project Configuration. Review Pending is removed while SBR, FLR, retrain-only, reboot and power cycle remain prohibited substitutes.
decision_basis: XLSX row 2129, same-row DeepSeek columns, GPT V2, historical record, unique identity and ED-01 through ED-30 were reviewed; actual next formal row Functionality 2130 / Wistron-HGX NV PVP HW-00007-V002 / 90b14b7e86e80822 was directly read from XLSX and manifest.
Bind the pinned NVQual Test #26 revision, exact root-port/switch/retimer/endpoint/GPU link hierarchy, stable device identities and out-of-scope sibling set.
Quiesce consumers and preserve/hash baseline topology, inventories, link state and logs rather than clearing evidence.

Treat each cycle as atomic: pre-state, scoped disable acknowledgement, expected endpoint absence, sibling continuity, enable, LTSSM/retrain/re-enumeration, required generation/width, complete identity and driver/GPU readiness, timing and fresh errors.
Iteration count/timing are signed inputs; the 600-minute allocation remains formal coverage and cannot be replaced by a short smoke run.

Stop on wrong-scope disable, failed disable/enable, missing/misbound/downtrained endpoint, sibling effect, driver/GPU failure, hang/unplanned reboot, disqualifying error/reset, artifact gap or safety anomaly.
Do not force rescan/rebind or escalate to SBR/FLR/reboot/power cycle as a successful result. Preserve first fault and never retry automatically.
No NVQual/link control, PCIe query, log clearing, rescan/rebind, reset, reboot, power cycle, recovery, retry or DUT operation was performed.

test_case.test_name: Scoped identity-complete HGX NVQual Test #26 link enable/disable interoperability
test_case.purpose: Prove every approved Test #26 cycle disables only the intended PCIe link and returns all expected NVIDIA endpoints at required generation/width and functional health without hang, unplanned reboot or disqualifying errors.
required_package: Pinned NVIDIA NVQual Test #26 link-control package/configuration with compatible firmware/driver
Signed root-port/switch/retimer/endpoint/GPU/sibling hierarchy and stable identity map
Signed iteration count/timing, durable atomic cycle ledger and first-fault interlock
Dedicated idle HGX SUT, BMC/console, stable power/cooling and out-of-band recovery
test_case.test_command: BLOCKED until Project Configuration is signed. Export/hash baseline logs, topology and inventories. After point approval run only the pinned Test #26 link disable/enable primitive; per cycle durably record pre-state, scoped disable/absence, sibling continuity, enable, retrain/re-enumeration, link generation/width, full NVIDIA identities, driver/GPU readiness, timing and error/health deltas before another cycle. Stop on first anomaly; do not rescan, rebind, reset, reboot, power-cycle or retry.
test_case.expected_result: Every configured cycle is contained to the intended link, proves expected disappearance and return by deadline, restores all stable NVIDIA identities at required generation/width and functional readiness, keeps siblings healthy, passes all Test #26 items, and causes no hang, unplanned reboot/reset or disqualifying errors.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: No PASS until Test #26 manifest, hierarchy/sibling scope, quiesce/control/return contract, iterations and recovery are approved. PASS requires every complete accepted cycle. FAIL on wrong scope, failed disable/enable, missing/late/misbound/downtrained device, sibling/function impact, hang/reboot, disqualifying error or failed recovery. Missing input/artifact is BLOCKED; escalation/retry cannot erase failure.
safety_gate: Gate CLOSED until exact primitive/hierarchy, blast radius, quiesce, timing/acceptance, ledger/interlock and recovery are signed.
Preserve baseline evidence and validate link ownership before any control write.
Use an isolated idle SUT with console and explicit link-disruption authorization.
Stop without rescan/rebind, reset/reboot/power escalation or retry at first anomaly.
expected_evidence: Exact row/variant/hash, owner-approved Test #26 manifest/configuration and authorization
HGX/tool/firmware/driver/BMC identities plus complete link/sibling/endpoint/GPU stable-identity topology
First-fault/out-of-band recovery or clean final topology/link/device/host state, no-retry audit and engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: At wrong-scope disable, failed disable/enable, missing/late/misbound/downtrained device, sibling/function impact, hang/reboot, disqualifying error or artifact gap, inhibit later cycles and preserve the first event. Do not force rescan/rebind or substitute any reset/power action; follow signed out-of-band recovery and quarantine if expected topology/health is not restored.
